title.narrative: The Global Cleantech Innovation Programme for SMEs in Ukraine

description.narrative: The global Cleantech programme is in line with the GEF#s Climate Change Mitigation Focal Area Strategy under the GEF-6 Programming Directions and the Private Sector Strategy, as well as UNIDO#s mandate to promote inclusive and sustainable industrial development (ISID). This project was developed further to a request by Ukraine to UNIDO to develop a project that would create green jobs by promoting clean technology innovation and entrepreneurship.
